status: Feature-led Orka overview with one security workflow example. Retained footage supplies the evidence. Shared Teams chats are explicitly marked as coming soon.

scenes.text: Orka is a platform for running and governing AI agents. Bring your own agents, coordinate work across teams, and choose their tools and skills. Control permissions, reuse reviewed knowledge, and track task results and token usage.
Security agents scan source code on a schedule to find undiscovered security vulnerabilities. You review a finding in Teams and ask Engineering to prepare a fix.
The agents trace an image URL into a server command and record evidence from the code.
In Teams, Orka Bot explains the finding. You decide whether to request a fix.
You request the fix. A custom demo integration sends the finding to Engineering, using that team's permissions.
The engineering agent prepares the patch and reports three passing focused tests. Orka publishes separately, keeping Git credentials outside the coding agent.
The patch and test results are ready in a pull request for your review.
Track reported token usage for each task.

Connect through Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Scout, Telegram, Slack, or your own gateway. Orka support for shared Teams chats is coming soon, so teammates can work with agents together. Run native agents in Kubernetes, optionally with Agent Sandbox and Agent Substrate. Connect local agents running in containers on your laptop, Foundry hosted agents, or your own compatible agent.
This is one example of how Orka coordinates agents, tools, and teams. Bring your own agents, connect your channels, and build workflows for your organization.
